What are some must play PSP games. For me Lumines is a must play for the system. Lumines is a puzzle game that looks kind of like Tetris with blocks coming down. Th goal is to score points by matching colors into a 4 x 4 blocks or more as a slider goes across the screen to clear your matches. The game is a ton of fun and can be really challenging. The music is awesome and really makes getting to new levels more enjoyable with the theme changing for each song. There is also a challenge mode that puts you into competition against an opponent. If you have more scores in a wipe their play area gets smaller making it harder to get scores. This is one of my favorite PSP games; what are some of yours?
